tei:div.tei:p: (nya)༄༅// dpal tshogs kyi bdag po'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa bzhugs so//

gser chos/ ༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ bi nā ya ka rā dza sā dha nā maḥ bod skad du/ bgegs kyi rgyal po'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ dpal rdo rje mkha' 'gro la phyag 'tshal lo// ma mo'i khyim dang nyams dga' bar// bsgom pa bzang po pa ba nyid// 'bad pas bris skur dmigs nas ni// sngags mchod blo gros ldan pa yis// gar mkhan bcing pa brtag gnas pa// dpal tshogs bdag chen po zhabs g.yas brkyangs pas gnas pa/ sku mdog dmar po'i 'od dmar po 'bar bas 'khrugs pa zhal gcig pa/ spyan gsum pa/ glang chen gdong la ral pa'i dbu rgyan bcings/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ bong ge thung la sbom pa rags pa/ gsus pa 'khyil zhing che ba/ shin tu 'jigs pa'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ phyag bcu gnyis pa/ g.yas dang pos dgra st+wa/ gnyis pas gtun shing*/ gsum pas mda' gzhu/ bzhi pas kha ṭwāṃ ga lnga pas lcags kyu/ drug pas thod pa khrag gis bkang ba'o// g.yon pa dang pos rdo rje/ gnyis pas ral gri/ gsum pas thod pa sha chen pos bkang ba/ bzhi pas phub chung*/ lnga pas ba dan rtse gsum pa/ drug pas 'phang mdung bsnams pa'o// padma dmar po dang nyi ma'i gdan la gnas pa'o// oṃ gaḥgaḥsiddhi siddhi sarba artha me pra sā dha ya hūm̐ hūm̐ dzaḥdzaḥswā hā/ dngos grub dngos grub don thams cad bdag la sgrubs shig dgugs pa'i sngags so// oṃ āḥgaḥhūm̐ swā hā/ bzlas pa'i sngags so// stong phrag brgya yis 'grub 'gyur bas// phyi nas las rnams yang dag brtsam// lan cig yongs bzlas thig le byas// sngags pa skal bzang mthong na dga'// rgyal po'i sgo ru ches mchod cing*// dgra rnams thams cad 'jigs par byed// bgegs rnams nye bar skrod nyid dang*// 'dod pa kun gyi 'bras ster bar// the tshom med pa nyid du 'gyur// de lta'i cho ga bsgrubs pa nyid// ma mo rnams ni 'grub pa'i mchog /dpal bgegs kyi rgyal po'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/

grub pa'i brtul zhugs brnyes pa'i slob dpon nag po spyod pas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //paṇḍi ta ga ya dha ra dang*/ lo tsā ba gyi jo zla ba'i 'od zer gyis bsgyur ba'o// //maṅga laṃ// ༈ /dpal tshogs kyi bdag po'i sgrub thabs bzhugs so// na mo gu ru ratna wardha ya/ rnal 'byor pa dbang dang rjes gnang thob cing dam tshig dang ldan pas chos dang mthun pa'i 'byor pa rgyas pa'i ched du tshogs kyi bdag po bsgrub par 'dod pas/ sngon tu gnod sbyin bse gdong can la cho ga bzhin mnan pa byas la/ dben pa'i gnas su maṇḍal la padma 'dab brgyad dmar po bri/ de'i dbus su zla gam dmar po la tshom bu dmar po dgod/ de'i steng du rten gtor nor bu'i dbyibs can la cho ga bzhin du bris pa'i bris sku 'dzugs par gsungs na'ang*/ phyag len la maṇḍal gyi steng du bris sku/ bris sku'i zhal gyi g.yon zur ngos su rten gtor/ g.yas ngos su 'das gtor/ mdun du rgyun gtor bsham pa mdzad/ gang ltar yang gtor ma rnams kyi mthar dkar gsum mngar gsum/ la du/ la phug spod sna tshogs btab pa'i ril bu mar du bcos pas brgyan/ mchod 'go g.yas nas brtsams pa'i chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod tshar gnyis dang*/ rang gi mdun du nang mchod rdo rje dril bu rnams bsham/ mchod pa byin rlabs bde mchog ltar byas la/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du 'gro bas rang skad cig gis 'byung po 'dul byed du gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas bla ma dang 'byung po 'dul byed la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ bhū ta ḍā ma ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ zhes sogs chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod kyis mchod/ gur nas 'byung ba'i rgyun bshags bya/ tshad med bzhi bsgom/ oṃ shū n+ya tā sogs nas haṃ zhes brjod pas gzung 'dzin gnyis snang gis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis ma dmigs pa'i stong nyid 'od gsal spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba nam mkha' lta bur gyur/

stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ yig las byung ba'i rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ rwa ba/ drwa ba/ gur/ bla bre/ ye shes kyi me phung rab tu 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i srung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du/ pam̐ las padma dang ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ mthing nag las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid khro bo'i rgyal po 'byung po 'dul byed sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas dang pos rdo rje ba dan rtse gsum dang ldan pa dang*/ g.yon dang pos thod khrag lcang lo dang ldan pa thugs kar 'dzin pa/ 'og ma gnyis mda' gzhu rgyab nas 'gengs pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs shing spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ ha ha'i gad rgyang gis sum cu rtsa gsum la sogs pa'ang 'jigs par mdzad pa/ sma ra dang smin ma dang dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rin po che dang sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs gsol ba/ mi ro'i steng na zhabs g.yas bskum zhing g.yon brkyang ba'i stabs kyis ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ yig las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad khro bo'i rgyal po 'byung po 'dul byed kyi rnam par oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs la/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par bstim/ slar yang thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥzhes pas spyan drangs la/ oṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ sarba ta thā ga ta/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ badzrī bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ zhes gsungs zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan par mos la tshogs zhing gi skabs ltar mchod/

'bar ba'i sku can nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi// dpa' bo'i stangs stabs zhabs kyis sa 'og g.yo// rab tu khros pa'i khro gnyer glog stong 'khyug /dpal chen 'byung po'i dgra la phyag 'tshal lo// bzhad pa'i nga ros sum cu rtsa gsum 'jigs// kun tu thogs med gdug pa'i mtshon cha bsnams// snying rje'i dbang gis zhi zhing 'gro la brtse// dngos grub stsol mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pas bstod/ nang mchod bde mchog ltar byin gyis brlabs pa/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis phul nas/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ yig la sngags kyis bskor ba dmigs nas/ sumbha brgya rtsa la sogs pa bzlas pa'i mthar/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas gdan 'od zer gyi rnam par gyur nas rang la thim par bsam/ de nas mdun gyi nam mkhar khro bo chen po bskyed/ yan lag bzhi rdzogs dang*/ mchod bstod gong bzhin bya/ 'das gtor nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ bhū ta ḍā ma ra'i mthar a kā ro btags pas dbul la mchod bstod gsol ba gdab/ rten gtor nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgyas zad mi shes pa'i longs spyod chen por byin gyis brlabs la bris sku bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las rang nyid khro bo chen por gsal ba'i mdun du bai ḍūrya'i brag ri'i khrod du padma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar nor bdag byi ba sngon po rin po che sna tshogs skyugs pa'i steng du gaḥyig dmar po yongs su gyur pa las dpal tshogs kyi bdag po sku mdog dmar po glang po che'i gdong pa can rno zhing dkar ba'i mche ba rab tu gtsigs shing spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ dbu skra ral pa'i thor cog nag po spyi bor bcings pa'i rtser yid bzhin gyi nor bus mtshan zhing dar dmar po'i cod pan 'phur ba/ phyag bcu gnyis kyi g.yas pa drug na dgra st+wa mda' chen lcags kyu rdo rje ral gri 'phangs mdung rnams 'dzin pa/ g.yon pa drug na gtun shing gzhu kha ṭwāṃ ga khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa sha chen gyis gang ba phub dang lhan cig tu mdung la ba dan btags pa rnams 'dzin pa/

g.yas g.yon gyi bzhi pa'i phyag mtshan rdo rje dang thod khrag thugs kar 'dzin cing lhag ma rnams 'phyar ba'i tshul gyis bzung ba/ dar sna tshogs kyi sham thabs gsol zhing*/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyangs pa'i skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis 'od zer dmar po rab tu 'khrugs pa'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i dbus su gaḥyig dmar po/ de nas rang nyid khro bo chen por gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas sum cu rtsa gsum gyi gnas nas dpal tshogs kyi bdag po'i sku'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa spyan drangs te mdun gyi tshogs kyi bdag po la thim par mos la/ dril bu gsil zhing*/ oṃ gaḥgaḥsiddhi siddhi sarba artha me pra sā dha ya hūm̐ hūm̐ dzaḥdzaḥswā hā/ zhes brgya rtsa la sogs mang du brjod pas bkug pa/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes brjod pas mdun du bsgoms pa dang gnyis su med par gyur par mos te/ de la oṃ padma ka ma lā ya st+waṃ zhes pas gdan phul nas sa ma ya hoḥ zhes pas dam la bzhag slar yang thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas dbang lha spyan drang ba sogs gong bzhin byas nas/ chu lhag ma yar lud pa las 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan par mos la/ byin gyis brlabs pa'i mchod pa rnams/ oṃ ga ṇa pa ti arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ zhes sogs kyis dbul/ me tog dmar po dang spos sna tshogs phul la/ rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs rdo rje// gnyis med ye shes las byung ba// tshogs rje tshogs dbang tshogs kyi bdag /bgegs kyi gtso la mchod cing mchod// me tog la sogs mchod pa dang*// la du la sogs mthun rdzas kyis// bgegs rgyal tshogs bdag 'khor bcas mchod// dngos grub thams cad bdag la stsol// zhes sogs ci shes kyis bstod/ rgyun gtor mkha' 'gro spyi gtor ltar byin gyis brlabs la/

ga ṇa pa ti la nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags btags pas dbul/ mchod bstod 'dod don zhus la/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer dmar po 'phros pas bris sku'i thugs ka'i gaḥyig sngags kyis bskor ba la phog pas thugs brgyud bskul bas skye 'gro dbang du bsdus shing zas nor gyi char babs nas dngos grub thams cad stsal bar bsam zhing*/ sumbha brgya phrag la sogs pas 'go drangs pa'i/ oṃ āḥgaḥhūm̐ swā hā/ zhes pa 'bum phrag gcig gam 'bru 'bum bzla/ oṃ ba ra ka tā ya swā hā/ oṃ wa ka te ka daṃṣṭa bhindha hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ bhrūm̐ ga ṇa pa ta ye swā hā/ zhes pa rnams dang grub na gzungs kyang ci nus bzla'o// spro zhing nus na bum pa cho ga bzhin bcas par 'byung 'dul bskyed bzlas byas pa'i chus bris sku me long gi ngos la shar ba la sku khrus gsol/ rin po che sna tshogs bkod pa'i maṇḍal dang mchod rdzas rnams 'dod yon lngar dmigs la/ me tog phreng ba la sogs rin chen dbyig /la du la phug 'bras bu yid 'ong zas// phyogs bcu'i chu skyes thang skyes longs spyod rkyen// ris ma bcad pa'i mchod sprin rgyas par 'bul// maṇḍal dam pa rab tu mdzes pa dang*// bshos gtsang mar me yon chab sna tshogs dang*// 'bras chang rgun chang la sogs btung ba'i mchog /sbrang rtsi bu ram la sogs mngar ba'i ro// lhan gyi skyes dang rab tu sbyar ba yi// sna tshogs mchod pa dam pa 'di dag bzhes// ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgya'i rnam 'phrul las// byung ba'i bla med mchod pa 'di dag 'bul// gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya la sogs pa'i// 'dod yon tshogs kyi mchod pa bzhes su gsol// bdag nyid dang bas bshams shing sprul pa yi// mchod pa'i tshogs kyis lha chen mnyes gyur cig /ces pas mchod bstod/ bsnyen pa rdzogs nas rten gtor nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ bsnyen sngags la a kā ro btags pas phul/

mchod bstod 'dod don zhus te nam mkha'i lha gshegs su gsol/ bris sku la brtan bzhugs byas pa/ rten gtor dang bcas pa bang mdzod la sogs pa gzhan gyis mi mthong ba'i sar bzhugs su gsol/ rang gi gnas gsum bsrungs la dge ba bsngo zhing bkra shis dang dga' ston rgyas par bya'o// dpal tshogs kyi bdag po khams gsum gyi 'khor los sgyur ba po sgrub pa'i thabs 'di ni/ dpal sa skya'i rje btsun chen po dang chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa'i gdams pa ji lta ba bzhin du btsun pa dkon mchog lhun grub kyis e waṃ chos ldan du bris pa'o// snod min la gsang zhing sba bar bya'o// maṅga laṃ// ༈ /dpal tshogs kyi bdag po'i rjes gnang gi cho ga 'dod dgu'i char 'bebs bzhugs so// na mo gu ru ratna wardhā ya/ dpal tshogs kyi bdag po'i rjes gnang bya ba'i tshul ni/ rgyal phur 'dzom pa'i tshe dben pa'i gnas su maṇḍal dang*/ bris sku dang mchod gtor la sogs pa sgrub thabs nas 'byung ba ltar bsham/ slob dpon gyis mchod pa byin rlabs nas brtsams te/ bdag bskyed 'byung 'dul gyi sgom bzlas/ mdun gyi nam mkhar 'byung 'dul bskyed de/ mchod gtor 'bul ba/ bris sku tshogs bdag tu bskyed pa la mchod bstod gtor ma 'bul ba sgrub thabs bzhin byas la/ dbang thob cing dam tshig dang ldan pa'i slob ma nyi shu rtsa lnga man khrus byas/ phyag dang yon phul te 'khod pa la/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya ba dang*/ gnas skabs su chos sgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen bar chad zhi zhing mthun rkyen phun sum tshogs par bya ba'i ched du/ khro bo 'byung po 'dul byed dang dpal tshogs kyi bdag po sbags te sgrub pa'i rjes su gnang ba gsan la don nyams su blang bar bgyi'o snyam pa byang chub kyi mchog tu thugs bskyed pa gsal btab nas gsan par zhu/ de la sngon gyi lo rgyus ni/

lha dbang phyug chen po'i sras tshogs kyi bdag po dang*/ kārti ka gnyis yin pa la/ lha dang lha ma yin 'thab pa'i tshe/ tshogs bdag gi ske lha ma yin gyis bcad pa na/ 'tsho mi 'tsho dbang phyug chen pos mngon shes kyis brtags pas/ mgo bo bcad ma thag drod ma yal ba zhig sbyar rgyu rnyed na 'tsho bar shes te/ 'khor rnams la lam du su 'phrad pa zhig gi mgo bo chod la shog ces bsgos nas btang bas/ 'khor rnams glang po che'i phrug gu zhig dang 'phrad de/ de'i mgo mo bregs nas khyer te 'ong ba/ tshogs bdag gi ske la sbyar bas 'byar te gsos so// skabs shig na tshogs bdag spun gnyis kyis sor rdo'i rtsed mo byas pas/ kārti kas sor rdo 'phangs pas tshogs bdag gi mche ba g.yon pa la phog ste chag pas/ tshogs bdag na re/ nga'i lus kyi lang tsho nyams par byas pas ngan pa 'di gsod zer ba la/ dbang phyug na re da lta ma gsod/ rgan gzhon khyod rang tsam du song ba na sod ces smras nas/ bu chung ba mi rgas par byin gyis brlabs/ sa gzhon nu kārti ka zhes grags/ de nas tshogs bdag sus kyang thul bar ma nus par/ nyin mo 'jig rten khams thams cad myul du phyin nas 'jig rten pa thams cad phung bar byed/ phyi dro khyim du 'ongs dus/ 'khor ma rnams kyis rol mo dang bcas te bsu ba byed pa la/ bcom ldan 'das kyis kho thugs rje chen pos 'dul bar gzigs nas/ thugs rje chen po la 'dzum pa zhig mdzad pa'i 'od zer gyis bskul bas/ thugs rje chen pos kyang sku dngos kyis mi thul kho rang dang 'dra ba zhig gis thul bar mkhyen nas/ phyi dro'i tshe snga bar tshogs bdag gi gzugs su sprul nas byon pas kho'i 'khor ma rnams kyis rol mo dang bcas pas bsu ba byas nas nang du gdan la bzhugs te/ bza' btung dang mchod pa phul nas yod pa la/ tshogs bdag gis 'jig rten gyi khams nyul nas log 'ongs pa na/ bsu ba byed pa ma byung pas khros nas 'khor ma rnams la chad pa'i las bya snyam du sems shing nang du phyin pas 'khor ma rnams na re/

'o cag gi tshogs bdag ni da ci nas byon nas yod/ ngan pa 'di su yin phyir song zer ba la/ rngam 'khrugs kyang thugs rje chen po'i byin rlabs kyis cang smra bar ma nus so// de nas thugs rje chen pos kho btul nas dam la btags pas/ khos kyang sems can la gnod pa mi byed par bslab pa gsum dang ldan pa'i chos pa rnams kyi longs spyod dang phrin las bsgrub par dam bcas te/ de ltar ma byas na rang gi mgo bo a rdza ka'i dog pa ltar 'gas par gyur cig ces dmod btsugs pa yin pas/ da lta'ang rgyal phur 'dzom pa'i nyin par kho 'jig rten khams thams cad myul zhing chos byed pa rnams kyi mthun rkyen bsgrub par khas blangs pa yin pas rjes su gnang ba'ang de lta bu'i nyin bya dgos pa yin/ de la spyir bcom ldan 'das kyis 'khor lo bde mchog gi bshad pa'i rgyud rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i rgyud gsungs pa'i tshe/ khro bo 'byung po 'dul byed ces bya ba/ 'jig rten pa thams cad 'dul ba dang*/ 'byung po thams cad kyi gnyen por sprul zhing*/ de'i tshe 'jig rten pa rnams kyi nang nas tshogs kyi bdag pos de'i bka' bzhin du bsgrub par khas blangs pa la brten nas/ rgyud de'i le'u bcu dgu pa'i stod nas 'byung po 'dul byed kyi sgrub thabs dang*/ le'u de nyid kyi smad nas tshogs kyi bdag po'i sgrub thabs gsungs pa yin pas/ rjes gnang dang bsnyen sgrub la sogs pa gang byed kyang lha gnyis po sbags te bya dgos pa yin/ de la 'dir rjes su gnang ba bsgrub pa la/ slob dpon gyis bgyi bar 'os pa thams cad grub/ slob ma'i bya ba la rjes gnang gi sngon du 'gro ba/ slob dpon la khro bo 'byung po 'dul byed dngos yin snyam pa'i mos gus dang ldan pas rjes gnang zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal phul nas me tog dang bcas pas thal mo sbyar te gsol ba 'debs pa'i rjes zlos lan gsum brjod/

kun mkhyen ye shes sogs nas/ gnang bar mdzod/ ces gsol ba btab pas/ rgyud dag pa'i slad du mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i khro bo 'byung po 'dul byed tshogs kyi bdag po dang bcas pa la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba sprin phung 'thibs pa bzhin du bzhugs par mos pa byas/ de dag gi spyan sngar bdag gzhan gyi tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa bshags pa la sogs pa'i yan lag bdun pa bgyi snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum la sogs nas 'grub par shog ces pas rgyud dag par byas nas/ thun mong ma yin pa'i gsol ba 'debs pa'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad dang sogs nas/ stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba 'debs pa rnams rjes gnang gi sngon 'gro yin/ dngos gzhi la sku'i rjes gnang gi slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon dang mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas khyed rang gi lus la phog pas tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad sbyangs te lus dri ma dang bral ba'i rang bzhin du gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de la dmigs te slob dpon gyis/ oṃ shū n+ya tā sogs nas haṃ zhes brjod pas gnyis snang gis bsdus pa'i zhes sogs nas/ mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan par mos pa mdzod/ ces pa'i bar sgrub thabs ji lta ba bzhin gyis slob ma khro bo yan lag bzhi rdzogs su byas la/ de ltar khyed rang khro bo chen por gsal ba'i mdun du bai ḍūrya'i brag ri'i khrod du zhes sogs nas/ 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan par mos pa mdzod/ ces pa'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin brjod de/ de ni sku'i rjes gnang yin/ gsung gi rjes gnang gi slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ yig sngags kyi phreng ba dang bcas pa las sngags kyi phreng ba byung*/

zhal nas thon/ khyed rang gi zhal du zhugs/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ yig gi mthar g.yas skor du 'khod par mos pa byas nas/ me tog dang bcas pas thal mo sbyar te 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ oṃ sumbha ni sogs nas hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod nas khyed rang gi mdun gyi dpal tshogs kyi bdag po'i thugs ka'i gaḥyig las sngags phreng byung ba khyed rang khro bo chen por gsal ba'i lte ba'i gnas su thim par mos pa mdzod la/ sngags 'di rnams kyi rjes zlos lan gsum gsum mdzod/ oṃ āḥgaḥhūm̐ swā hā/ zhes sogs nas swā hā zhes sngags tshan bzhi po lan gsum re bzlas pas dang pos rgyud byin gyis brlabs/ gnyis pas dbyer med du byas/ gsum pas brtan par byas par mos te/ slob dpon la drin lan gyi tshul du me tog gtor nas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bcom ldan bdag gis sogs nas mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas slob dpon gyis kyang me tog gi phreng ba sngags su byas te khyed rang gi spyi bor bzhag cing byin gyis brlab pa'i mos pa mdzod/ bcom ldan 'di la sogs nas/ brtul zhugs brtan par mdzad du gsol// zhes brjod pas/ lha gnyis kyi gsung gi rjes gnang thob pa yin snyam du mos pa mdzod/ thugs kyi rjes gnang gi slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas mdun gyi tshogs kyi bdag po'i thugs ka'i gaḥyig la phog pas srog rgyud bskul te gaḥlas 'od zer dmar po bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros pas/ sum cu rtsa gsum gyi gnas nas tshogs bdag dang gter bdag nor bdag dang gzhan yang 'jig rten gyi khams kyi dregs pa can thams cad kyi thugs rgyud bskul bas de rnams kyi skye 'gro bsod nams can rnams kyi lung dang mngon par rtogs pa'i tshe dang bsod nams dang*/ dpal dang 'byor pa dang*/ nor dang 'bru dang*/ g.yang dang mdangs dang*/

gzi brjid dang*/ 'byung ba bzhi'i bcud thams cad bsdus nas khyed rang la byin pas/ rang gi gnas khang dang*/ bang mdzod dang*/ yul phyogs thams cad khengs pas longs spyod 'dod dgu phun sum tshogs pa la dbang bar byas pa yin snyam du mos pa mdzod/ khyad par du tshogs kyi bdag po'i zhabs g.yon pa'i rting pas zhabs 'og gi byi ba la brdabs pas des ma bzod de 'jig rten gyi khams kyi zas nor thams cad bsdus nas khyed la phul zhing byi ba'i kha nas rin po che sna tshogs skyugs pas khyed rang gi gnas khang dang bang mdzod ces sogs gong bzhin brjod pa'i mthar dril bu gsil zhing*/ oṃ gaḥgaḥsiddhi siddhi sogs nas swā hā zhes mang du brjod pas thugs rgyud bskul nas/ bka' bsgo ba ni rten gtor slob ma'i lag tu gtad de sngags rnams kyi mthar/ dpal tshogs kyi bdag pos rdo rje slob ma 'di rnams kyi lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs nas/ dus da nas bzung ste byang chub ma thob kyi bar gyi 'gal rkyen bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi ba dang*/ bsrung ba dang*/ skyob pa dang*/ sba ba dang*/ 'go ba'i phrin las mdzod cig mthun rkyen tshe dang bsod nams dang dpal dang 'byor pa dang dbang phyug thams cad gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzod cig lha 'dre mi gsum gyi 'gro ba mang po dbang du bsdus nas zas gos longs spyod thams cad kyis phongs pa med par yid bzhin du 'byor pa dang*/ de dag gis kyang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang sems can mang po la phan pa dang bde ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'byung ba dang*/ mthar thug rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa'i phrin las mdzod cig ces bka' bsgos pas tshogs kyi bdag pos de ltar bgyi'o zhes zhal gyis bzhes te khyed rang gi phyi bzhin du 'brang ba'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas mdun bskyed kyi nam mkha' na bzhugs pa'i khro bo chen po'i thugs ka nas khro bo chen po'i sku de 'dra ba zhig byon pa khyed rang gi spyi gtsug nas zhugs te snying gar padma dang nyi ma'i gdan la bzhugs nas rgyud byin gyis brlabs pa yin snyam du mos pa mdzod/

de rnams kyis khro bo chen po dang dpal tshogs kyi bdag po'i rjes su gnang ba grub pa yin/ de dag gi gnas skabs su thob pa'i dam tshig la bsrung bsdam bgyi snyam pas/ gtso bos/ maṇḍal/ deng nas sogs spyi dang 'dra/ lha gnyis mchod de nam mkha'i lha gshegs su gsol/ bris sku la brtan bzhugs bya ba sogs sgrub thabs bzhin bya'o// dpal tshogs kyi bdag po'i rjes gnang gi cho ga 'di yang don gnyer rnams la phan pa'i ched du btsun pa dkon mchog lhun grub kyis e waṃ chos ldan tu sbyar ba'o// snod min la gsang zhing sba bar bya'o// ༈ /oṃ swa sti/ tshogs bdag gi sgrub thabs su mchod pa byin rlabs bde mchog ltar bya zhes gsungs pa ni/ rdo rjes nang mchod gtor la/ sumbhas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las gnas khang bhrūm̐ las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i thar pa chen po'i gzhal yas khang pa gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhis mdzes pa rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du hūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri mchog zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa dwangs shing thogs pa med pa byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po lta bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ dus 'khor ba ji srid ma stongs kyi bar du rgyun mi chad par gyur/ so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ nas shabda āḥhūm̐ gi bar dang*/ ghaṇḍe ra ṇi ta lan gsum brjod/ nang mchod byin rlabs rgyas par na bde mchog gi dkyil chog ltar ram/ bsdu na bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las a las byung ba'i thod pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ sha lnga/ bdud rtsi lnga las byung ba'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen po gyur/

oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥ lan gsum gyis byin brlab/ spro na sngags ring bzla bar gsungs pa ni/ tadya thā/ oṃ na maḥstu ti ma hā ga ṇa pa ta ye swā hā/ oṃ gaḥgaḥgaḥgaḥgaḥgaḥgaḥgaḥ oṃ ga ṇa pa ta ye swā hā/ oṃ ga ṇā dhi pa ta ye swā hā/ oṃ ga ṇe shwa rwa ya swā hā/ oṃ ga ṇa pa ti pū dzi te swā hā/ oṃ ka ṭa ka ṭa/ ma da ma da/ da ra da ra/ bi da ra bi da ra/ ha na ha na/ gṛhṇa gṛhṇa/ dhā wa dhā wa/ bhañdza bhañdza/ stambha stambha/ mo ha mo ha/ de hi de hi/ da da pā ya da da pā ya/ dha na siddhimme pra yatstsha/ na maḥstu te ma hā ru dra pa tsa nā ya swā hā/ oṃ āḥbhū ta bhantu kṣu ba ta ra tu ma hā swā hā/ sa ma gatstshanta te na maḥ.a mṛ ta bhintu kṣu ta tsitta ma hā sa ma/ gatstsha ti ma hā/ bha ya ma hā/ bā la pra kra ma/ ma hā ha to/ pra bho da da mi swā hā/ oṃ na maḥstu te ma hā ga ṇa pa ta ye swā hā/ oṃ gaḥgaḥgaḥgaḥgaḥgaḥgaḥgaḥg ṇa pa ta ye swā hā/ oṃ ga ṇā dhi pa ta ye swā hā/ oṃ ga ṇe shwa rā ya swā hā/ oṃ ga ṇa pa ti pū dzi tā ya swā hā/ oṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ oṃ mu ru mu ru swā hā/ oṃ na mo na maḥswā hā/ oṃ na maḥstu te ma hā ga ṇa pa ta ye swā hā/ ma ma sa pa ri wā ra sya sarba satwā nāñtsa sarba bighnān bi nā ya kā ni shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes pa'i/ bsnyen pa'i skabs/ thog mar 'byung 'dul gyi bdag bskyed dang 'brel bar hūm̐ bzhi'i sngags 'bum phrag gcig gam/ grub na 'bum phrag bzhi kha skong dang bcas pa bzla ba ni gong gnon gyi bsnyen pa dang*/ de nas sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyi sgo nas tshogs bdag gi bsnyen pa gzhung du gsal ba ltar bya/ spyir 'di'i gdams ngag thams cad bsdu na/ bsnyen pa/ sgrub pa/ las sbyor/ spog chog ste bzhir 'du ba las/ bsnyen pa la'ang gong gnon gyi bsnyen pa dang*/ tshogs bdag gi bsnyen pa gnyis/ phyi ma la/ 'gab 'dre mnan pa/ bris sku 'bri ba/

rten bca' ba/ bla rdo 'chang ba/ bsnyen pa dngos ji ltar bya ba'i tshul rnams dang*/ sgrub pa la dmigs pa'i khyad par/ gtang rag gi mchod chog dngos grub blang ba'i thabs rnams dang*/ las sbyor la sgrub pa chen po'i tshul dang las sbyor gyi tshul gnyis/ dang po la dbang gi las dang*/ nor sgrub pa'i las gnyis/ phyi ma la tsakra/ gri lag gter bum/ sbyin sreg gtor ma/ las phran tshegs te drug tsakra la rtsibs brgyad pa dang*/ bcu gnyis pa gnyis/ sbyin sreg la dngos dang*/ thab gter gyi cho ga rnams te/ 'phags pa rin po ches mdzad pa'i sgrub yig gi gzhung gsal byed kyi yig cha ji snyed pa dang*/ brgyud ldan gyi bla ma dam pa'i zhal lung las rtogs par bya ba kho na'o// sarba maṅgalaṃ bha ba tu// ༈ /gser chos tshogs kyi bdag po'i brgyud 'debs 'dod dgu'i mchog stsol ces bya ba bzhugs so// rdo rje 'chang chen rdo rje phag mo'i zhabs// sa ra ha pa klu sgrub ri khrod mgon// hang du dkar po mal lo brtse ba che// rje btsun sku mched rnams la gsol ba 'debs// 'jam mgon sa paṇa mtshungs med skyob pa dpal// shes rab seng ge bag ston tshul rgyal zhabs// ngag dbang grags pa byang chub seng ge dang*// ye shes rgyal mtshan rnams la gsol ba 'debs// ngor chen rdo rje 'chang dbang rgyal tshab che// dkon mchog 'phel dang lha mchog sangs rgyas seng*// thar rtse paṇa chen nam mkha' rin chen dang*// nam mkha' dpal bzang rnams la gsol ba 'debs// shes rab rgya mtsho sangs rgyas phun tshogs zhabs// bstan 'dzin lhun grub nam mkha' bsam 'grub dang*// kun dga' blo gros nam mkha' 'chi med dpal// rtsa ba'i bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs// de ltar gsol ba btab pa'i byin rlabs dang*// bsnyen sgrub las sbyor bogs 'byin rnal 'byor gyis// tshogs bdag dgyes pa'i nor bu'i sprin chen las// 'dod dgu'i gru char 'jo bar byin gyis rlobs// zhes pa'ang rje btsun rdo rje 'chang gsang ba 'dzin pa'i bdag po byams pa kun dga' bstan 'dzin las tshul 'di'i bka' drin thob pa mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos gsol ba btab pa siddhi rastu/

sarba dā maṅgalaṃ bha ba tu// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
